_comment: Calibrated 2026-11-06 (--force) after P00.T2: composer.json scripts, .github/workflows/ci.yml, phpunit.dist.xml, deptrac.yaml, .php-cs-fixer.dist.php and the Makefile are read from the real files. The host has no PHP: every PHP command runs in the running Docker 'app' service with `docker compose exec -T app …` from the checkout root (exec uses the container's own environment, so the Makefile's --env-file flags are not needed for exec; `make up` starts the stack). Those commands fail while the stack is down or in a checkout whose compose project has no running 'app' service. CI runs the same composer scripts on the runner's PHP 8.5.

checks._comment: composer scripts from composer.json, run in the Docker 'app' service (host has no PHP). `composer qa` (or `make qa`) runs validate, cs, rector, phpstan, deptrac, lint, audit and test in one go. `ci` names the CI job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. build and compose run on the host (Docker), like the CI build job.

validate.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer validate --strict

format.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer cs
format.scopedCmd: docker compose exec -T app vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php --dry-run --diff --show-progress=none --path-mode=intersection {files}
format.fixCmd: docker compose exec -T app composer cs:fix

rector.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer rector

static.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer phpstan

deptrac.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer deptrac

lint.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer lint

audit.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer audit

unit.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer test:unit

integration.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer test:integration

functional.cmd: docker compose exec -T app composer test:functional

e2e.ci: e2e (stub on pull requests until the Playwright journeys arrive in P00.T9)

_ciGate_comment: In CI order from .github/workflows/ci.yml: static job (validate, cs, rector, phpstan, deptrac, lint, audit), unit, integration (test:integration then test:functional, with postgres:18.6 and valkey 8.1.4 services), build (docker build --target prod, compose-config-check.sh). The jobs run in parallel on every push and on pull requests to main. e2e is a stub that runs nothing yet, so it is left out.

fastGate._comment: PHP and Twig run in the Docker 'app' service. No per-file `syntax`/`onEdit` for PHP: the on-edit hook passes the host's absolute path, which does not exist inside the container (it is mounted at /app), so `php -l` there would report a false error on every edit. The Stop gate passes paths relative to the checkout, so the scoped PHP-CS-Fixer run (about 0.4 s) and lint:twig (about 0.3 s) work; PHP-CS-Fixer also fails on a file it cannot parse. formatPaths match the finder in .php-cs-fixer.dist.php; --path-mode=intersection keeps its exclusions (config/reference.php). Both fail, not skip, while the stack is down.

languages.format: docker compose exec -T app vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php --dry-run --diff --show-progress=none --path-mode=intersection {files}
docker compose exec -T app php bin/console lint:twig {files}

patterns.message: Three or more comment lines inside a function body narrate the code. Keep the one line that says why (a constraint, a workaround); the story of the change belongs in the commit message.
Name the variable by what it holds (openTickets, parsedRound), not data/result/tmp/info/obj.
Don't drop extensions in down(): up() uses CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS and may not own them. Throw IrreversibleMigration ($this->throwIrreversibleMigrationException('...')) instead.

provenance.text: Plain `SET` and `set_config(…, false)` are forbidden (a static check looks for them).

patterns.message: Never set the tenant with SET / SET LOCAL / set_config(..., false); only the Doctrine TenantMiddleware sets it with SELECT set_config('app.org_id', :id, true) as a bound parameter.

provenance.text: Twig auto-escaping is always on. User text is never rendered with `|raw`.

patterns.message: Do not use |raw. Let Twig escape, and render the Markdown subset through the server-side HTML Sanitizer (sanitize_html).

provenance.text: CSP nonce helper for any `<script>` tag; no inline handlers.

patterns.message: No inline event handlers (the CSP blocks them). Use a Stimulus controller with data-action="click->name#method".

provenance.text: Worker mode is on (FrankenPHP). No static state, and services that hold state implement reset (ADR-0008).

patterns.message: No static properties or static variables in worker mode: they leak between requests. Keep state in a service property and implement ResetInterface.

provenance.text: No exclamation marks except in rare good news. No "Oops".

patterns.message: No "Oops" in product copy. Say what happened and what to do next, in one plain sentence.
Use keyset pagination (WHERE (sort_key, id) < (:last_key, :last_id) ... LIMIT n), not OFFSET or setFirstResult().

provenance.text: PHP 8.4+, `declare(strict_types=1);`, final classes by default, readonly value objects, constructor injection only.

patterns.message: Classes are final by default (CLAUDE.md). Add `final`, or `abstract` for a base class; if it must be extended, add `// hygiene:allow` with the reason.

taskGate._comment: Kept empty: every heavier check needs the Docker stack; the Stop gate's scoped checks cover the per-task boundary.

browser._comment: `make up` serves https://localhost (Caddy local TLS). The ports come from .env.local (HTTP_PORT, HTTPS_PORT) and the stack's other ports (MinIO, Mailpit) are fixed too, so a worktree cannot start a second stack beside the first: no {port} placeholder, and the stage refuses to reuse a busy address. There is no health route in the app; the home page (route web_home) answers when the stack is up. No login exists yet (P01), so no auth. Playwright resolves from node on this machine. Pages map only templates that exist today; the component gallery and assets/ arrive in P00.T5/T6.
